footer.brand: Thinking is useful, but it is easy to get lost in it. I am not convinced by wisdom that amounts to lecturing, mentoring, maintaining one's own narrative and cultivating one's image. When knowledge remains in words, quotes and winning arguments, it becomes another illusion. What matters to me is what is grounded in reality and can be tested beyond my own mind.
